description: An aerial orthophoto, likely from a satellite or high-resolution imagery, displaying distinct land cover types with numerical labels used for classification. The image centrally features a large, dark, circular area, labelled "312", which corresponds to the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) category for Coniferous forest. To the left of this feature, an area delineated by a yellow polygonal boundary is labelled "243", corresponding to CLC for Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation. A partially obscured label "112" is visible in the top-left corner, likely representing CLC Discontinuous urban fabric. The imagery is characteristic of examples used for Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) classification, potentially from coastal or dune environments such as the Maspalomas dune in the Canary Islands, the Doñana Natura 2000 site in Southern Spain, or a sand beach area like Sudersand, Sweden, as referenced in the surrounding document context.
